CAMBIE CREST CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL - Paediatric Emergency & Minor Procedures OPERATIVE NOTE (MINOR PROCEDURE) Patient: Anand Kenji Takeda-Raman DOB: 2059-11-05 Age: 6 y MRN: KM 5531-0922 Date of procedure: 2066-02-01 (Monday) Start 18:40 End 19:25 Surgeon: Dr. Rashida Oyelaran Assistant: Tobias Vandenberghe, resident Scrub nurse: Imelda Faulkner, RN PHN: 9876 543 210 Accompanied by: mother Priya Raman (at bedside, phone +1 604 555 0123)
PRE-OPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: Laceration of the right thigh, approximately 4 cm, with Stanley Park playground fence as the mechanism per mother. POST-OPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: Same. No foreign body. PROCEDURE: Irrigation, exploration and primary layered closure of laceration of thigh. ANAESTHESIA: Local (lidocaine with epinephrine), plus intranasal sedation. Weight 20 kg.
DESCRIPTION: The child was identified by wristband (Anand Takeda-Raman) and the time out was done. The wound was cleaned with saline and explored. The fascia was intact. Hemostasis was easy. Closure was in two layers with 4-0 absorbable sutures deep and 5-0 nylon sutures skin, seven in total. Tetanus was up to date per mother (Tdap booster not due). Dressing applied. The child tolerated it well and asked for a "sticker like my sister Mei's" - Mei is his 9 year old sister.
Copy forward (from 2065-12-30 note, unchanged by mistake): "Presents with sore ear, plan Amoxil x 10 days". [Not relevant today. Ear was normal.] Allergies: nil known. Meds: Tylenol or Motrin prn only.
DISPOSITION: Home. Sutures out in 10-12 days with family doctor Dr. Marguerite Lachance at Kitsilano Family Practice, or here. Wound care sheet given. Return if fever, redness or pus. No Bell's palsy, no Parkinson's, nothing neurological - template phrase from adult template, ignore.
Dictated by R. Oyelaran; electronically signed 2066-02-01 21:07. Last edited by tvandenb from 10.31.77.140.
